Terrorists Kill Two Migrant Workers in Kulgam

Terrorists killed two migrant workers in Kulgam, Jammu and Kashmir, on Tuesday. The victims, identified as laborers from Chhattisgarh, were reportedly asked for their names by the attackers before being shot. One worker died at the scene, and the other succumbed to his injuries later in the hospital. Following the attack, security forces launched a search operation and increased security measures across the valley. The Lieutenant Governor ordered "high-impact" operations against terrorists and announced ex-gratia compensation for the victims' families.
